info.name: Sportradar Push Feeds Competitors Soccer Push API

params.name: access_level
params.description: Sportradar access level for the requested package. Trial accounts use 'trial'; production customers use 'production'.

params.name: version
params.description: Sportradar Soccer API version (for example, v4).

params.name: sport_event_id
params.description: Limit the stream to a specific sport event identifier.

items.docs: Opens a long-lived HTTP chunked connection that streams real-time match events across Sportradar's soccer coverage. Heartbeat messages are sent every five seconds when no new events are available. Use the optional sport_event_id filter to limit the stream to a single match.
